rev6.release_notes: G-SEND.IO: Simulate beside the code now plays lathe programs too, on real CNMG432 / VNMG332 turning holders (Tools > Lathe Simulator opens it); mill tools sit in the CAT40 ER32 holder. CAD CAM: File > Simulate G-code... plays any lathe or mill program with its code beside it (also SIMULATE... in the Post window), and Simulate draws the real turning and CAT40 holders.
